headers.comment: Collage SVGs, tiles, shapes, noise tile, meadow.mp4 and the logos. These are referenced by literal /images/... URLs from /public, so Astro never content-hashes them and they inherited no cache rule at all — only /_astro/* gets one, from the adapter. Every visit was re-validating ~3MB of art. Filenames here are stable (collage-001.svg etc), so a year is safe. IF YOU RE-EXPORT A SHAPE, GIVE IT A NEW FILENAME — immutable means returning visitors will not re-fetch a changed file.

Deliberately 7 days, not a year, because the h1 face is being swapped and these filenames are not content-hashed — a year of immutable would strand returning visitors on the old font. Once the font files carry a version in the name (Geist-Variable-v2.woff2), raise this to 31536000 + immutable to match /images.
